breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly rejects the resultant load replacement method ('Do not use the resultant load replacement method') and instead instructs using the standard analytical approach for cantilever beams with uniform distributed loads. This correctly resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly claimed that replacing the UDL with its resultant at midspan would give exact deflection results. The generated specification aligns with the ground truth, which simply asks for deflection and slope under the actual UDL without any resultant substitution.
